body:
Hey There!

This is just a forum game i used to host and it was fun with what sentences they came up with. So what do we do here I start with a sentence the beginning of the story amd after that the next person that reads it can write another sentence and this will go on for a long time i hope. I have no idea if someone hosted this before if so now its back.

Rules:
-You have to wait for 3 other people to respond after your sentence.
-No sexual sentences.
-No discrimination.
-No hurting others (Aiming with a sentence to someone to hurt his feeling) 
-Have fun
-And just all the other inappropriate  stuff i think you can come up with the rest of the list.

so I'll start: 
Once upon a time there was a player called Bob.

Now the next person needs to give another sentence good luck!

Omg already so many sentences to i was like let's put them now all in a big story here it comes:

Once upon a time there was a player called Bob. Bob is mean, he eat my potato. Which is why I have chosen to hunt him down. I tracked him down to the nearest Walmart, Unsheathed my katana, and stabbed him on the back. However, He became an angel and hit a car with My potato, and then he Turned into a demon for being a bad angel. Once Bob turned into a demon, he shoved my potato up his blender, then he put it in a computer and played avicus until he Killed himself, but avicus lag back made him survive so he ate a potato That he threw away because it was a poisonous one so he grabbed a massive television and threw it at his mom, then proceeded to Make a smoothie for his dog and then played with his dog at Chuck E Cheese, and decided to build a "club" with Ari dancing in it to the nize jam by MidnightBeats, who was dj-ing hardcore.

MidKnightStorm, the mineplex warrior, decided to grief and destroy his club out of jealousy. Angered, Bob then killed all dogs, and spared none regardless of the old lady who decided to track Bob down and whip him with her cane. In hospital, Elsa had just given birth to her's and Riley's newborn, son, his name was GrapeSmoothi and, he was really fat. And a good painter… 

The End.

But wait, there's more. GrapeSmoothi turned out to be having A demotion on avicus. He then proceeded to Spam the forums with Make the entire server, forums, and teamspeak go down! But when he did that…


Sessp called his ex-girlfriend who turned out to be Funkystudios himself.
